title.zh: Why GENIUS could leave digital dollars vulnerable to sudden blockchain network ‘bank runs’
title.en: Why GENIUS could leave digital dollars vulnerable to sudden blockchain network ‘bank runs’

current_state.zh: A Federal Reserve staff paper suggests that network fee spikes could trigger stablecoin 'bank runs' even with full reserve backing, while the GENIUS Act does not directly address public-chain fee and capacity risks.
